title: Public eval suites allowlist
description: Decides which raw eval suites in gs://guidance-evals are rebuilt into the public copy. Changed by pull request only. This file documents the shape for editors; src/harness/public/allowlist.ts enforces the same rules natively at load time and before every write, plus the rules a schema cannot express (wildcard include patterns must start with nightly-; each suite has at most one overrides entry).

include.description: Suite IDs or glob patterns (* and ? only) that are eligible for publishing, e.g. nightly-*-codex_cli.

exclude.description: Exact suite IDs that must not be published even if they match include.

releasedModels.description: Model identifiers (as recorded in evals.json#model) that may appear publicly. Empty means nothing publishes.

retention.description: How much history stays published. Older or surplus suites are dropped from the public copy on the next build; their raw data is untouched.

maxAgeDays.description: Drop suites whose raw evals.json is older than this many days.

maxSuites.description: Keep at most this many of the newest publishable suites in total (unreleased runs do not count).

maxSuitesPerAgent.description: Keep at most this many of the newest publishable suites per agent, applied before maxSuites, so one agent cannot age the others out.
